<USER_SCRIPT>
CORAL — A SUMMER LAUNCH

Scene 1 — 5s
Hard morning sun floods a white Bondi studio apartment through open glass doors. SCARLETT (19, sun-kissed blonde in an oversized white linen shirt) pads barefoot across the pale wooden floor, ocean breeze lifting the curtains and the loose ends of her hair as she crosses toward a sunlit vanity.

Scene 2 — 5s
At the vanity Scarlett’s hands open a small cream matte package, lift out the coral lipstick tube and turn it slowly so the bullet catches the directional window light. She looks from the vivid #D4536D colour to her bare reflection and gives a tiny private nod.

Scene 3 — 6s
She applies the coral lipstick in one clean pass across her lower lip then upper, presses her lips together once, then leans closer to the mirror. The fresh coral sits bright against warm skin; a small unguarded smile breaks as she decides the colour is already hers.

Scene 4 — 5s
Scarlett stands, slips the tube into the pocket of her light linen shorts, snatches a striped beach towel from a chair and walks straight out the open door into the bright morning, the quiet apartment falling away behind her.

Scene 5 — 5s
Wide on the Bondi promenade under high clean sun. Scarlett walks toward camera along the path, blonde hair whipping sideways in the sea wind, coral lips the sharp colour pop against white linen and pale concrete, soft-focus surfers carrying boards behind her. She glances once toward the water and almost laughs.

Scene 6 — 5s
She stops and leans both elbows on the white railing overlooking the beach. Full ocean wind hits her face; she turns into it, eyes closed for a beat, then opens them and touches a fingertip lightly to the corner of her mouth, checking the colour still holds perfect.

Scene 7 — 5s
Down on the shoreline she kicks off her sandals, leaves them with the towel on dry sand and walks straight into the shallow wash. White foam rushes over her bare feet and ankles; she laughs out loud and takes two more steps deeper into the cool water.

Scene 8 — 6s
A gentle wave breaks near her, spray misting her legs and the hem of her shirt. She dips both hands into the water and runs cool wet fingers back through her hair, then stands smiling into the salt air, coral lipstick still crisp and bright against the morning light.

Scene 9 — 5s
Locked three-quarter beauty frame: Scarlett’s face with sun and open ocean behind her, the coral lips the clear hero colour. She presses her lips together once more, the shade unmoved by water and wind, then turns her head toward the horizon with a quiet, certain grin.

Scene 10 — 5s
Wide final shot: Scarlett walks alone along the wet packed sand at the water’s edge, parallel to the shore, footprints washing away behind her. Hair free, shirt billowing, she pulls the lipstick tube from her pocket, glances at it with a small private smile, slips it back and keeps walking into the bright open day.
</USER_SCRIPT>
